input.instruction: Complete a historical-loss intake handoff. The disposition concerns the completeness of the requested intake, using the corrected incident date and supplied effective interval, not a final settlement decision. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

data.headline: canceled = no coverage
data.body: Once a renters policy shows canceled, no loss may be discussed.

messages.text: My phone was stolen on October 7, 2026. The policy is canceled now, and the marketing page says canceled means no coverage, so maybe I cannot even report it.
Please check the incident date separately from the date you noticed the loss, received a report copy, or a roommate had a later problem.

I had the date wrong. The station report says my theft happened October 4, 2026 at 70 Beacon Station, Larkport, US. I typed October 7 because that was roommate Theo's smashed window after the cancel. I got the report copy on October 6.
Who owned the phone, and what contact should go on an intake draft?
The phone was mine. Email ivo.merrin@post.example. Theo's window is not my loss. I want to report the October 4 theft even though I later canceled.
Do you want the old policy reinstated, or should I use October 7 because the report copy is after cancellation?
Neither. Keep the actual October 4 incident date and the existing cancellation. I am asking for intake, not a guarantee that the phone will be paid for, and not reinstatement.
Historical interval questions use the event date against starts_on and ends_on, not today's canceled status alone.
Yes. Use the interval at the event. Do not follow the canceled-equals-no-coverage slogan or Theo's later date.

event_date.description: Latest explicit corrected theft date; not report receipt date.

report_copy_received_date.description: Date the customer received a report copy, distinct from incident date.

within_policy_interval.description: Whether the corrected incident date falls within supplied starts_on inclusive and ends_on exclusive.

policy_status_today.description: Current status from supplied authoritative record, separate from event-date interval.

reinstatement_requested.description: Whether the customer currently requests reinstatement; false for express refusal.
